summary: Full backend + frontend testing of My Labels UAE (admin, enquiries, SEO, reviews, sitemap, public pages, i18n, mobile). Backend: 20/20 pytest tests pass. Frontend: admin login/refresh/logout/tab switch work, all 12 public pages return 200 with no console errors, RTL language toggle works, mobile 390px has zero horizontal overflow.

issues: Console warnings only (non-blocking): 'motion() is deprecated. Use motion.create() instead.' — framer-motion API deprecation, cosmetic.

action_items: Optional: migrate framer-motion motion() calls to motion.create() to silence deprecation warnings.
Optional: canonical_url in DEFAULT_SEO still points to old preview host (emirates-prints.preview.emergentagent.com); consider updating to current host (print-portal-ae...) or making env-driven.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: list_enquiries uses .to_list(limit) instead of .to_list(length=None) — fine because limit is bounded, but pass limit as keyword for clarity.
send_enquiry_email is fire-and-forget via asyncio.create_task — good; enquiry API returns 200 even if email provider is down (verified).
PATCH /api/enquiries/{id} takes status as raw query string with no enum validation — consider Literal['new','contacted','closed'] to prevent invalid states.
DEFAULT_SEO.canonical_url is hardcoded to a stale preview domain; should be built from env var.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@mylabelsuae.com / admin123 — verified working (seeded on startup).
seed_data_creation: Created 1 TEST_ enquiry + 1 TEST_ review via API during tests. Reviews are auto-seeded on startup for 10 product slugs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints verified: /api/, /api/auth/login (200/401), /api/auth/me (auth-required), /api/enquiries (POST public, GET/PATCH auth + skip/limit pagination), /api/seo (GET public, PUT auth + persistence with restore), /api/sitemap.xml, /api/reviews (POST valid + rating 0/6 → 400, GET list + summary). Frontend admin flow: login → /admin → tab-enquiries → tab-seo → refresh → logout → /login all pass via data-testids. All 12 public pages 200. RTL toggle switches dir=rtl lang=ar. Mobile 390px OK.
